in_sanskrit.name: Piku
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Bird, Small, Playful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Piku एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Piku is derived from the Sanskrit word 'pik' which means a small bird. It also has a playful and joyful meaning. This name is often used in Bengali culture and is considered a cute and adorable name for a baby girl.
